planets.name: TOI-763 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-763 with a 12.3-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-763 c was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-763. Its orbit and size follow Fridlund et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
